top_news.title: Layer-wise Curriculum Learning for Efficient LLM Compression
top_news.dek: Layer-wise curriculum learning improves LLM compression by partitioning models into segments to optimize knowledge transfer from teacher to student.
top_news.brief: This approach addresses cumulative error by breaking the model into layer segments. By starting with simpler optimization tasks and progressing to harder ones, the method accelerates convergence during the compression process.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing model segmentation for layer-wise knowledge transfer

top_news.title: A heap overflow and SSO misconfiguration to compromise OpenAI internal repos
top_news.dek: Researchers compromised OpenAI internal repositories by chaining a heap overflow in libheif with an SSO misconfiguration.
top_news.brief: The exploit chain involved a vulnerability in the libheif image decoder, which was leveraged to gain access to employee ChatGPT accounts. This access allowed the researchers to interact with internal monorepos, demonstrating a significant security gap.

top_news.title: OpenAI Introduces Triage Framework and Case Studies to Report Model Misalignment
top_news.dek: OpenAI released a new triage framework and case studies to standardize the reporting and analysis of model misalignment.
top_news.brief: The framework allows employees to flag unexpected model behaviors, which are then labeled and analyzed by technical staff. The initiative aims to provide transparency into model deviations, though it has met with mixed reactions regarding its corporate implementation.
top_news.image_alt: Flowchart of the model misalignment reporting process

top_news.title: Alibaba Qwen Releases Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash: A 1M-Context Omni-Modal Model Built Around Agentic Audio-Video Understanding and Tool Use
top_news.dek: Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash is a new 1M-context omni-modal model designed for agentic audio-video understanding and tool use.
top_news.brief: The model integrates audio, video, image, and text processing into a single architecture. It is capable of task planning and tool execution, and is currently available via API on Alibaba Cloud and QwenCloud.

top_news.title: prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf (0 downloads, 522 likes)
top_news.dek: Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf offers 27B-class reasoning in a 5.9GB package using ternary weights for efficient local inference.
top_news.brief: This model achieves ~98% of FP16 intelligence while being 9.3x smaller. Optimized for llama.cpp, it runs on consumer hardware, reaching approximately 47 tokens per second on an Apple M5 Max.
top_news.image_alt: Bonsai logo and performance metrics chart

primary.title: Google Research Introduces Retrieve-for-Train (R4T): An RL-Compiled Diffusion Retriever for 12× to 20× Faster Query Fan-Out
primary.summary: Google Research has introduced Retrieve-for-Train (R4T), a framework for search that returns coherent, diverse result sets. It trains a fan-out language model with RL once, using groundedness, diversity, and alignment rewards. That model then synthesizes training data for a 53.9M-parameter diffusion retriever. The retriever generates all retrieval directions in a single pass, running 12× to 20× faster than autoregressive fan-out. No code or model weights have been released yet.
